title: 第4746章 是时候清场了第4745章 我的坟墓
slug: 九阳武神第4746章是时候清场了
content_zh:
还有一些老鬼伸手一指，就能利用强大的鬼气能量入侵生灵的魂海，让对方产生各种恐怖无比的幻象。
黄裳看到这片空间源源不断冒出来的数量众多的老鬼，并没有感到惊喜，反而是暗暗吃惊，因为他感觉像是有人在控制着这一切。
“这到底是怎么回事呢？”
黄裳全力收敛自己的气息，隐匿身形，躲在一个角落之处，观察着这片空间中的各种变异。
而这个时候，那些正在围攻那十几头开天神级别老鬼的强者，也注意到了这个坟墓内空间好像出现了什么异常的情况，一个个都放慢了攻击的节奏，开始相互传音进行讨论。
不过让人感到奇怪的是，那个样貌普通的生灵，已经走近了十几头开天神级别的老鬼，但是在周围那些强者的眼中就好像透明一般，根本就没人注意到他。
“鬼丞相当年送给我的这些鬼将、鬼兵，依然还是这么好用。”
那个生灵看着眼前源源不断冒出来的老鬼，轻声说道。
“这是怎么回事？
这个空间竟然藏着这么多的老鬼！
那个家伙是谁？”
就在这个时候，黄裳终于注意到了那个样貌普通的生灵。
黄裳的感知能力其实比那些开天神还要强一些，特别是在这种环境之中，黄裳的感觉能力更加是超出平时。
所以当其他那些开天神强者都没有感觉到那个普通生灵的时候，黄裳首先感觉到了不对劲。
“这个家伙虽然表面看起来普普通通，但是他随便站在那里，就好像掌控了整个空间。
这里的空间、时间、能量、法则以及其它一切的东西，好像都在拥他为主，他就像是这里的主人一般。”
黄裳敏锐地感知到了这一点，然后大惊失色，开始悄悄后退。
这个时候，黄裳已经不打算再继续吞噬这里的老鬼了，而是想要离开，因为有一种巨大的危机感正在这个空间之中悄悄弥漫。
“闯进我的地盘，动我的手下，你们这些家伙就别走了。”
那个样貌普通的生灵盯着一个开天神，轻声说道，然后伸手一抓。

轰隆隆……
周围空间中的空间、时间、能量、法则以及一切存在的东西都受他召唤，滚滚而来，化成了一只无形的大手，一下子就将那个开天神的躯体控制住。
“这是怎么回事？”
那个开天神感觉有一只无形的大手一把将自己抓住，然后就向前拉去。
这个开天神一边怒吼，一边施展种种手段，体内的神力能量犹如惊涛骇浪一般倾泻而出，朝四面八方冲撞出去，想要摆脱束缚。
但是没有用，那只无形的大手直接拉着他向前，接着他就看到前方出现了一张血盆大口，一口向他咬了过来。
其实这张血盆大口就是那个样貌普通的生灵的嘴巴，他一把将那个开天神抓过来，然后张开嘴巴，一口就将对方吞掉。
“不错，一个开天神能让我得到一些补充。”
那个生灵点了点头，而且嘴巴还吧唧了几下，显得津津有味，嘴角有一些鲜血渗透出来。
“这是怎么回事？”
其他的那些强者看到有一个血盆大口突兀出现，一下子就吞掉一个开天神，不由得大惊失色。
“啊……
content_en:
There are also some old ghosts who can use the powerful ghost energy to invade the soul sea of ​​living beings with just a finger, causing the other party to have all kinds of terrifying illusions.
Huang Shang was not surprised when he saw the large number of old ghosts popping up in this space. Instead, he was secretly surprised, because he felt like someone was controlling everything.
"What the hell is going on?"
Huang Shang tried his best to restrain his aura, concealed his figure, and hid in a corner, observing various mutations in this space.
At this time, those strong men who were besieging the dozen or so old ghosts with the level of gods also noticed that there seemed to be something abnormal in the space inside the tomb. They all slowed down the pace of their attacks and began to communicate with each other to discuss.
But what is strange is that the ordinary-looking creature has already approached more than a dozen old ghosts at the level of gods, but it seems to be transparent in the eyes of the strong men around them, and no one notices him at all.
"These ghost generals and ghost soldiers that Ghost Prime Minister gave me last year are still so useful."
The creature looked at the old ghosts that kept appearing in front of him and said softly.
"What's going on?
There are so many old ghosts hiding in this space!
Who is that guy? "
At this moment, Huang Shang finally noticed the ordinary-looking creature.
Huang Shang's perception ability is actually stronger than that of those Kaitian gods. Especially in this environment, Huang Shang's perception ability is even more than usual.
So when the other powerful Kaitian gods didn't feel the ordinary creature, Huang Shang first felt something was wrong.
“Although this guy looks ordinary on the surface, he seems to control the entire space just standing there.
The space, time, energy, laws and everything else here seemed to support him, and he was like the master here. "
Huang Shang keenly sensed this, then turned pale with fright and began to retreat quietly.
At this time, Huang Shang no longer planned to continue to devour the old ghosts here, but wanted to leave, because there was a huge sense of crisis quietly filling this space.
"Break into my territory and use my men, you guys just don't leave."
The ordinary-looking creature stared at an open god, whispered, and then stretched out his hand to grab it.
Rumble…
The space, time, energy, laws and everything that existed in the surrounding space were summoned by him, rolled in, and turned into a big invisible hand, controlling the body of the God of Heaven in one fell swoop.
"What's going on?"
The Kaitian God felt an invisible hand grabbing him and then pulling him forward.
This Kaitian God roared while using various methods. The divine energy in his body poured out like a stormy sea, rushing out in all directions, trying to get rid of his restraints.
But it was useless. The invisible big hand pulled him forward, and then he saw a bloody mouth in front of him, and it bit him.
In fact, this bloody mouth was the mouth of that ordinary-looking creature. He grabbed the Kaitian God, then opened his mouth and swallowed him in one bite.
"Yes, an Kaitian Shen can give me some supplements."
The creature nodded, and smacked its mouth a few times, appearing to be enjoying it, and some blood seeped out of the corners of its mouth.
"What's going on?"
The other strong men were horrified when they saw a bloody mouth suddenly appearing and swallowing an Kaitian God in one fell swoop.
"ah……
